entries.english:
[Extra mode] lets you explore dungeons independently of story progress.
When entering a dungeon, you can choose to play as Torneko or Tipper, take Rosa or Ines with you, and more.
If you take Rosa or Ines along, your adventure also ends in failure if your companion falls.
Adventures in [Extra mode] leave no records in Adventure history or High scores.
You cannot bring items back to use on your next adventure.

The Trial of illusion has special rules: defeating monsters will not raise your level, and Tipper cannot recruit monsters. Bear this in mind.
entries.notes: Independent translation from the pinned Japanese. Existing Adventure Log, mode, character and dungeon identities are reused. Adventure records refers to the separate history/high-score profile. Earlier pointer owners and unreviewed high data-table references remain unchanged. Dungeon rules are translated from this game's Japanese, without importing mechanics from another game.
